1 SCOPE
This standard specifies the requirements for portable pneumatic sanders having nominal diameter of pads/abrasive coated discs up to 230 mm.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which through reference in his text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of these standards:
